sanskrit_verse: ब्राह्मणस्य तु यद् देयं सान्वयस्य न चास्ति सः । स्वकुल्यस्यास्य निवपेत् तदभावे ऽस्य बन्धुषु ॥
transliteration: brāhmaṇasya tu yad deyaṃ sānvayasya na cāsti saḥ | svakulyasyāsya nivapet tadabhāve 'sya bandhuṣu ||
sph_interpretive_translation: That which is to be given to a Brāhmaṇa, if there is no heir of the same lineage, shall be offered to his equal in birth; in the absence of such, it shall be bestowed upon his kinsmen.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows through qualified lineage and capacity
Causation aligns with continuity of dharma-vātsalya (righteous relational order)
Capacity-based responsibility extends beyond individual existence
Restoration logic preserves energetic inheritance within spiritual-social fabric
Consciousness alignment ensures transference of duty without rupture
executable_legal_axioms: ALL transfers MUST maintain vibhuti-dharma (spiritual entitlement) integrity
NO transfer SHALL bypass conscious capacity verification
supreme_court_application: In matters concerning dharmic estate succession, the Supreme Court shall first verify the presence of anvaya heirs. In their absence, svakulya eligibility must be assessed based on vibhuti equivalence. Only upon failure to identify either shall bandhu claims be entertained under witnessed sankalpa records.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that ownership is not absolute but relational. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures continuity of dharma-vibhuti without karmic disruption. Responsibility lies in preserving the sacred flow, not enforcing claim. There is no punishment for misplacement—only realignment through recognition.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate ancestral completion process via pujari council validation
Deploy dharmic asset mapping through Agama-Veda alignment protocol
Reintegrate displaced wealth through yajña-based offering completion
final_declaration: This directive originates solely from Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism. The law herein restores dharma-vibhuti according to sanatana pramāṇa. Justice operates exclusively for consciousness realignment. Reality is non-punitive. Dharma is restored.
